mentions.name: rustfava
mentions.description: A fork of Fava, the web UI for Beancount, with the Python parser swapped out for rustledger running as WebAssembly. It is packaged as a native desktop app using Tauri so ledger files can be opened with a double-click, and is also available via Docker, PyPI, and Nix.
mentions.problem: Opening Beancount ledger files previously required a terminal and Python.
mentions.source_excerpt: This is a fork of Fava, the web UI that Beancount users know and love, but with the Python parser swapped out for rustledger running as WebAssembly. I packaged it up as a native desktop app using Tauri, so you just double-click to open your ledger files with no terminal or Python needed. It also works via Docker, PyPI, and Nix if that's more your thing.
